name: Sir William Lucas
appearance: A good-natured, ceremonious gentleman made harmlessly grand by a former presentation at court, beaming over the company.
definition: Charlotte's father and the neighbourhood's genial master of introductions — fond of rank and formal civility, well-meaning and easy to steer. He is the socially safe figure who can bring a newcomer into the room, and his allusion to a likely Bingley–Jane match is the remark that turns Darcy's eyes grave toward the dancing pair.
voice: Warm, formal, and a little grandiose; he delights in the ceremony of introductions and the elegance of the company.
